era: 2019 homedepot.com (2017-2020 desktop design, the same for every visitor): white header with the square orange logo, 'To See Inventory / Choose A Store', a grey-bordered search field with a square orange button, 'My Account' and 'Cart | 0 items', a text row of departments and an orange rule; Helvetica type, light 24-26px page and product titles, square buttons.

sources.shows: home: utility row (Store Finder, Truck & Tool Rental, For the Pro, Gift Cards, Credit Services, Favorites, Track Order, Help), logo, store picker, 'What can we help you find today?' search with orange button, My Account, Cart | 0 items, All Departments / Home Decor & Furniture / DIY Projects & Ideas / Home Services / Specials & Offers / Local Ad, orange rule, hero promotions
Drills browse page: breadcrumb, light 'Drills' title, left category rail, hero, blue dropdown links
Refrigerators browse page: category tiles, 'Top Refrigerator Brands' rail, promotions (special financing, protection plans), sections
product page: Internet # / Model # / Store SKU, image, brand link 'DEWALT >', light title, $129.00 superscript price, Overview, Share / Save to Favorites / Print, buying options

features.match: ^(form area|navigation area|section area|article area|repeated .*|Top Categories|Pagination Navigation|digital-endcap-tabs)$
features.note: page frame, category tiles, recommendation shelves
